pages.text: A bee works at full speed in its $(l)home dimension$(). Anywhere else, modded dimensions too, its hive keeps it twice as long.$(br2)Bees with two homes are at full speed in both. Bees at home in any dimension never slow down.
In the Nether and the End there is no night or weather: bees there work all the time. Starlight bees work all the time in the End, under open sky, and never in the Nether.
